1.w: For indeed, concerning the ministry to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you⁺.

2.w: For I know your⁺ readiness, which I boast of to Macedonians on behalf of you⁺, that Achaia has been prepared from a year ago, and your⁺ zeal provoked the greater part.

3.w: But I sent the brothers so that our boasting that [is] on behalf of you⁺ in this matter should not be made void, so that you⁺ may be prepared, as I have been saying—

4.w: lest perhaps if Macedonians should come with me and should find you⁺ unprepared, we would be put to shame—not that we might say you⁺—in this confidence.

5.w: Therefore I deemed [it] necessary to exhort the brothers that they should go before to you⁺ and should complete beforehand your⁺ foreannounced blessing, thus [for] this to be ready as a blessing and not as covetousness.

6.w: Now this: The one sowing sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one sowing upon blessings will also reap upon blessings,

7.w: each as he has purposed in the heart, not out of grief or out of necessity. For God loves a cheerful giver.

8.w: And God [is] able to make all grace abound to you⁺, so that in every [way], always, having all sufficiency, you⁺ may abound to every good work.

9.w: As it has been written: “He scattered abroad; He gave to the poor; His righteousness remains to the age.”

10.w: Now the One supplying seed to the one sowing and bread for food will supply and will multiply your⁺ seed and will increase the fruits of your⁺ righteousness,

11.w: being enriched in every [way] to all generosity, which produces through us thanksgiving to God.

12.w: For the ministry of this service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also abounding through many thanksgivings to God,

13.w: through the proof of this ministry, glorifying God upon your⁺ submission of confession to the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of the fellowship to them and to all.

14.w: And their supplication [is] for you⁺, longing for you⁺ on account of the surpassing grace of God upon you⁺.

15.w: Thanks [be] to God for His indescribable gift!
